args.title: Document accepted amount formats for uploads in API reference
args.body:
File: docs/api-reference/uploads.md

Add documentation describing which amount formats are accepted in uploads, including use of a dot for decimals, commas for thousands, leading + or - signs, parentheses for negatives, and leading currency symbols like €, $, £, or ¥. This clarifies how amounts can be formatted in uploaded data, improving the accuracy and usefulness of the API reference.
